title: Default CSV rerun picker to audit reports
summary: Default the Launch CSV rerun path picker to the resolved audit report export folder when the CSV field is empty.
reason: Audit rerun CSV exports are written under the backend-resolved audit_reports_path, so Browse should open there by default instead of relying on the operating system's last picker location.
behavior_before: The Launch rerun CSV Browse action sent an empty initial_path when the CSV Path field was empty, leaving the native file dialog to choose a generic or previous location.
behavior_after: The backend path-picker command uses resolved.audit_reports_path as the initial path for launch.rerun_csv when the field is empty, while preserving an explicit staged CSV path when present.
rollback_plan: Revert the commands_path_picker.py initial-path helper changes and the two path-picker unit tests, then refresh the same generated summaries.
notes:
